title: दशमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 10 · Yudhishthira hears of the massacre

summary.en: Next morning Dhrishtadyumna's charioteer tells Yudhishthira of the night's slaughter, and the king falls in grief. Yudhishthira goes to the camp and sees the dead, and weeps over the sons and friends.
summary.kn: ಮರುದಿನ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನನ ಸಾರಥಿ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಹತ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ರಾಜ ದುಃಖದಿಂದ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶಿಬಿರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಹತರನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ಮಿತ್ರರಿಗಾಗಿ ಅಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अगली सुबह धृष्टद्युम्न का सारथी युधिष्ठिर को रात के संहार की सूचना देता है और राजा शोक से गिर पड़ते हैं। युधिष्ठिर शिविर जाकर मृतकों को देखते हैं और पुत्रों तथा मित्रों के लिए रोते हैं।
summary.te: మరుసటి ఉదయం ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుని సారథి రాత్రి సంహారాన్ని యుధిష్ఠిరునికి చెబుతాడు; రాజు దుఃఖంతో కూలుతాడు. శిబిరానికి వెళ్లి హతులను చూసి కుమారులు, మిత్రుల కోసం ఏడుస్తాడు.
summary.ta: மறுநாள் காலை த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னனின் தேரோட்டி இரவின் படுகொலையை யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் கூற, மன்னர் துயரத்தால் வீழ்கிறார். பாசறை சென்று மாண்டோரைக் கண்டு மக்களுக்காகவும் நண்பர்களுக்காகவும் அழுகிறார்.
summary.ml: പിറ്റേന്ന് രാവിലെ ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നന്റെ സാരഥി രാത്രിയിലെ കൂട്ടക്കൊല യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ അറിയിക്കുന്നു; രാജാവ് ദുഃഖത്തിൽ വീഴുന്നു. യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പാളയത്തിലെത്തി മരിച്ചവരെ കാണുന്നു; പുത്രന്മാരെയും സുഹൃത്തുക്കളെയും ഓർത്ത് വിലപിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 10.10; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Fri Oct 30 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सारथिः ।
शशंस धर्मराजाय सौप्तिके कदनं कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: When that night had passed, the charioteer of Dhrishtadyumna told Dharmaraja of the massacre in the night attack.

verses.text:
द्रौपदेया महाराज द्रुपदस्यात्मजैः सह ।
प्रमत्ता निशि विश्वस्ताः स्वपन्तः शिबिरे स्वके ॥

meaning.en: The sons of Draupadi, great king, with the sons of Drupada, heedless and trusting, were sleeping at night in their own camp.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मणा नृशंसेन गौतमेन कृपेण च ।
अश्वत्थाम्ना च पापेन हतं वः शिबिरं निशि ॥

meaning.en: The cruel Kritavarman, Kripa of Gotama's line and the sinful Ashvatthaman destroyed your camp at night.

verses.text:
एतैर्नरगजाश्वानां प्रासशक्तिपरश्वधैः ।
सहस्राणि निकृन्तद्भिर्निःशेषं ते बलं कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Cutting down thousands of men, elephants and horses with spears, javelins and axes, they left your army without remnant.

verses.text:
छिद्यमानस्य महतो वनस्येव परश्वधैः ।
शुश्रुवे सुमहाञ्शब्दो बलस्य तव भारत ॥

meaning.en: The great roar of your force, O Bharata, was heard, as of a great forest being cut with axes.

verses.text:
अहमेकोऽवशिष्टस्तु तस्मात्सैन्यान्महीपते ।
मुक्तः कथंचिद्धर्मात्मन्व्यग्रस्य कृतवर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: I alone of that army am left, O king; by some means I escaped, righteous one, while Kritavarman was distracted.

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यमशिवं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
पपात मह्यां दुर्धर्षः पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing those ill words, Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, hard to overcome, fell to the ground, overcome by grief for his sons.

verses.text:
तं पतन्तमभिक्रम्य परिजग्राह सात्यकिः ।
भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ॥

meaning.en: As he fell, Satyaki ran to him and held him, and so did Bhimasena, Arjuna and the two Pandava sons of Madri.

verses.text:
लब्धचेतास्तु कौन्तेयः शोकविह्वलया गिरा ।
जित्वा शत्रूञ्जितः पश्चात्पर्यदेवयदातुरः ॥

meaning.en: Having recovered his senses, Kunti's son, afflicted, lamented in a voice troubled by grief, conquered after conquering his enemies.

verses.text:
दुर्विदा गतिरर्थानामपि ये दिव्यचक्षुषः ।
जीयमाना जयन्त्यन्ये जयमाना वयं जिताः ॥

meaning.en: The course of events is hard to know, even for those with divine sight; the conquered conquer, and we who were conquering are conquered.

verses.text:
हत्वा भ्रातॄन्वयस्यांश्च पितॄन्पुत्रान्सुहृद्गणान् ।
बन्धूनमात्यान्पौत्रांश्च जित्वा सर्वाञ्जिता वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Having slain brothers and companions, fathers, sons and groups of friends, kinsmen, ministers and grandsons, we are conquered by conquering all.

verses.text:
अनर्थो ह्यर्थसंकाशस्तथार्थोऽनर्थदर्शनः ।
जयोऽयमजयाकारो जयस्तस्मात्पराजयः ॥

meaning.en: Misfortune looks like gain, and gain looks like misfortune; this victory has the look of defeat; therefore this victory is a defeat.

verses.text:
यं जित्वा तप्यते पश्चादापन्न इव दुर्मतिः ।
कथं मन्येत विजयं ततो जिततरः परैः ॥

meaning.en: One who, having won, afterward suffers like an unfortunate fool, how can he regard it as victory? He is more conquered than those who lost.

verses.text:
येषामर्थाय पापस्य धिग्जयस्य सुहृद्वधे ।
निर्जितैरप्रमत्तैर्हि विजिता जितकाशिनः ॥

meaning.en: For whose sake we won this sinful victory, the killing of friends, shame on it; those who were defeated and watchful have conquered us, the victors.

verses.text:
कर्णिनालीकदंष्ट्रस्य खड्गजिह्वस्य संयुगे ।
चापव्यात्तस्य रौद्रस्य ज्यातलस्वननादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Those who in battle escaped from Karna, whose ear-shafts were fangs, whose sword was a tongue, whose mouth was a bow, who was fierce and roared with the slap of his bowstring,

verses.text:
क्रुद्धस्य नरसिंहस्य संग्रामेष्वपलायिनः ।
ये व्यमुच्यन्त कर्णस्य प्रमादात्त इमे हताः ॥

meaning.en: from that enraged lion among men, who never fled in battles, these men were killed through carelessness, having been freed from him.

verses.text:
रथह्रदं शरवर्षोर्मिमन्तं
रत्नाचितं वाहनराजियुक्तम् ।
शक्त्यृष्टिमीनध्वजनागनक्रं
शरासनावर्तमहेषुफेनम् ॥

meaning.en: They crossed a lake of chariots with waves of showers of arrows, filled with jewels and rows of mounts, with spears and javelins as fish, banners as elephants and crocodiles, bows as whirlpools and great arrows as foam,

verses.text:
संग्रामचन्द्रोदयवेगवेलं
द्रोणार्णवं ज्यातलनेमिघोषम् ।
ये तेरुरुच्चावचशस्त्रनौभि-
स्ते राजपुत्रा निहताः प्रमादात् ॥

meaning.en: the sea of Drona, with the rising of the moon of battle as its tide, the slap of the bowstring as the sound of its rim, and they crossed it with boats of weapons high and low; those princes were killed through carelessness.

verses.text:
न हि प्रमादात्परमोऽस्ति कश्चि-
द्वधो नराणामिह जीवलोके ।
प्रमत्तमर्था हि नरं समन्ता-
त्त्यजन्त्यनर्थाश्च समाविशन्ति ॥

meaning.en: For in this world of the living nothing is a greater destroyer of men than carelessness; for a careless man, prosperity leaves him from all sides, and misfortunes enter him.

verses.text:
ध्वजोत्तमाग्रोच्छ्रितधूमकेतुं
शरार्चिषं कोपमहासमीरम् ।
महाधनुर्ज्यातलनेमिघोषं
तनुत्रनानाविधशस्त्रहोमम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who, in a great battle, withstood the fire of Bhishma, which was like a vast forest fire, with the finest banners raised on high as smoke, arrows as flames, rage as its great wind, bows as its roar, armor and many weapons as its offering,

verses.text:
महाचमूकक्षवराभिपन्नं
महाहवे भीष्ममहादवाग्निम् ।
ये सेहुरात्तायतशस्त्रवेगं
ते राजपुत्रा निहताः प्रमादात् ॥

meaning.en: and which fell upon the great army as upon dry grass, with the speed of drawn and extended weapons, those princes were killed through carelessness.

verses.text:
न हि प्रमत्तेन नरेण लभ्या
विद्या तपः श्रीर्विपुलं यशो वा ।
पश्याप्रमादेन निहत्य शत्रू-
न्सर्वान्महेन्द्रं सुखमेधमानम् ॥

meaning.en: Neither learning nor austerity, nor fortune nor great fame can be won by a careless man; see Mahendra, who, by being careful, killed all his foes and thrives in happiness.

verses.text:
इन्द्रोपमान्पार्थिवपुत्रपौत्रा-
न्पश्याविशेषेण हतान्प्रमादात् ।
तीर्त्वा समुद्रं वणिजः समृद्धाः
सन्नाः कुनद्यामिव हेलमानाः ।
अमर्षितैर्ये निहताः शयाना
निःसंशयं ते त्रिदिवं प्रपन्नाः ॥

meaning.en: See the sons and grandsons of kings, equal to Indra, slain through carelessness without distinction, like prosperous merchants who crossed the sea and, mocked, sank in a bad little river. Those slain while lying down by the resentful have surely gone to heaven without a doubt.

verses.text:
कृष्णां नु शोचामि कथं न साध्वीं
शोकार्णवे साद्य विनङ्क्ष्यतीति ।
भ्रातॄंश्च पुत्रांश्च हतान्निशम्य
पाञ्चालराजं पितरं च वृद्धम् ।
ध्रुवं विसंज्ञा पतिता पृथिव्यां
सा शेष्यते शोककृशाङ्गयष्टिः ॥

meaning.en: I grieve for Krishna; how will that virtuous woman not perish today in an ocean of grief, hearing that her brothers and sons are killed, and her father the Panchala king and her aged father? Surely she will fall senseless on the ground and lie there, her slender body wasted with sorrow.

verses.text:
तच्छोकजं दुःखमपारयन्ती
कथं भविष्यत्युचिता सुखानाम् ।
पुत्रक्षयभ्रातृवधप्रणुन्ना
प्रदह्यमानेव हुताशनेन ॥

meaning.en: Unable to bear the pain born of that sorrow, how will she, used to comforts, be, driven by the loss of her sons and the killing of her brothers, as if burned by fire?

verses.text:
इत्येवमार्तः परिदेवयन्स
राजा कुरूणां नकुलं बभाषे ।
गच्छानयैनामिह मन्दभाग्यां
समातृपक्षामिति राजपुत्रीम् ॥

meaning.en: So lamenting in his distress, the king of the Kurus said to Nakula: "Go, bring here that unlucky princess, with her mother's side."

verses.text:
माद्रीसुतस्तत्परिगृह्य वाक्यं
धर्मेण धर्मप्रतिमस्य राज्ञः ।
ययौ रथेनालयमाशु देव्याः
पाञ्चालराजस्य च यत्र दाराः ॥

meaning.en: Madri's son, taking the word of the king who was like Dharma himself, according to dharma, quickly went by chariot to the house of the queen, where the Panchala king's wives were.

verses.text:
प्रस्थाप्य माद्रीसुतमाजमीढः
शोकार्दितस्तैः सहितः सुहृद्भिः ।
रोरूयमाणः प्रययौ सुताना-
मायोधनं भूतगणानुकीर्णम् ॥

meaning.en: Having sent off Madri's son, the descendant of Ajamidha, afflicted by grief, went with his friends, weeping, to the battlefield of his sons, thronged with hosts of spirits.

verses.text:
स तत्प्रविश्याशिवमुग्ररूपं
ददर्श पुत्रान्सुहृदः सखींश्च ।
भूमौ शयानान्रुधिरार्द्रगात्रा-
न्विभिन्नभग्नापहृतोत्तमाङ्गान् ॥

meaning.en: Entering that inauspicious, grim place, he saw his sons, friends and companions lying on the ground, their bodies wet with blood, their heads split, broken or carried off.

verses.text:
स तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा भृशमार्तरूपो
युधिष्ठिरो धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः ।
उच्चैः प्रचुक्रोश च कौरवाग्र्यः
पपात चोर्व्यां सगणो विसंज्ञः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them, Yudhishthira, best of those who uphold dharma and foremost of the Kauravas, in great distress cried out loudly and fell on the ground senseless, with his company.
